subject: Pricing: Omega - volume discount request
messages:
From: Annie Cho <annie.cho@omega-sys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing — volume bands and committed tiers

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the recent demo — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency and the KV cache behavior. We're moving from pilot to production and need to lock in economics. Current ask: expected steady-state consumption of ~5B tokens/month starting July, with peaks up to 7B.

Two asks:
- Can you share what a committed monthly tier discount looks like vs your public rate card? We need both 6- and 12-month commit options.
- Is there an option for a custom per-token band (not in the standard rate card) if we commit to a 12-month contract? Procurement will want unit economics and an SOW.

We're sensitive to cost — please include proposed overage rates and any required minimums. If this requires an exception/approval, tell me what you need from our side (LOE, PO, etc.).

Thanks,
Annie
Annie Cho
Head of AI Ops, Omega Systems
annie.cho@omega-sys.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: (none)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Annie Cho <annie.cho@omega-sys.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — volume bands and committed tiers

Hi Annie — great to hear the demo went well.

Short answer: yes, we can do committed tiers and we sometimes make custom per-token bands for enterprise customers, but those require a commercial exception and senior approval. I attached a preliminary worksheet with two scenarios (6mo ramp, 12mo full commit) so you can see the math.

Summary of what I sent:
- Public rate card (list) = $0.0010 / token (baseline for hosted models)
- Example 6-month commit for 5B tokens/mo -> illustrative discount to $0.00075/token (25% off) with overage at $0.0009
- Example 12-month commit for 5B tokens/mo -> illustrative custom band at $0.00060/token (40% off) with overage at $0.00075 and minimum monthly invoice

If you'd like the 12-month custom band we will need to run an internal approval (revenue ops + finance + legal). Can you confirm: expected term start (July 1), billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly), and whether Omega will sign standard MSA or require redlines? Procurement can send a PO but legal will need the SOW/MSA.

I'll escalate internally; attaching the worksheet (pricing_worksheet_omega.xlsx) for your review.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: pricing_worksheet_omega.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — volume bands and committed tiers (Omega) — approval request

Team — forwarding a request from Omega (Annie Cho). Key points:
- Targeted committed consumption: 5B tokens/month, peaks to 7B. Start date July 1.
- They asked explicitly for a custom per-token band for 12-month commit.
- Initial worksheet attached with two options (6mo ramp / 12mo full commit).

Ask: can we approve a custom per-token band at ~40% off list for a 12-month committed deal (OE: 0.00060/token) or do we hold to rate-card-based discounts (max 30% for hosted)? Please include margin impact and any required guardrails (minimum monthly invoice, overage pricing). Also flag if legal/finance needs to engage on MSA redlines or credit terms.

I've attached a short summary: Omega_Discussion_Summary.pdf and the pricing worksheet. If you prefer, I can propose a counter (30% off with 6-month ramp). Need guidance before I present firm numbers to procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachments: Omega_Discussion_Summary.pdf; pricing_worksheet_omega.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — volume bands and committed tiers (Omega) — approval request

Karthik — thanks for the summary. Reviewed the worksheet and the projected ARR. Thoughts:

- We can provisionally approve an exception to the public rate card up to 35% off list for a 12-month commit, subject to:
  - Minimum monthly invoice equal to 80% of committed tokens (to protect against churn-driven over-discounts)
  - Overage priced at no less than 0.00075/token
  - Signed SOW + standard MSA; any material redlines will void the provisional approval until legal confirms

- If Omega wants 40% off (the number they asked for), escalate to SVP Revenue (I want the margin impact and churn sensitivity model first).

Next steps for you: propose the provisional terms to Annie (35% off) and ask procurement to provide a PO and indicate whether they will accept the standard MSA. If they push for 40%, I will loop in SVP.

Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — volume bands and committed tiers (Omega) — approval request

Agree with Marissa. Two quick additions:
- Offer a one-time pilot credit (up to $25k) to accelerate the contract signature and address their short-term POC costs.
- Legal: Aditya, please confirm whether the standard MSA covers data residency/audit clauses they might ask for; if not, flag items for redline.

If legal signs off, I'm fine letting Karthik present the provisional 35% band and the overage/minimum protections.

—Sean

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Omega Systems Procurement <procurement@omega-sys.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — volume bands and committed tiers (Omega)

Annie / Michael — thanks for your patience. Internal approvals completed for a provisional commercial exception. Summary of provisional terms we can offer now:

- Committed tier: 12-month term starting July 1, 2026
- Committed volume: 5B tokens / month (billing month)
- Unit price on committed volume: $0.00065 / token (35% off our public list of $0.0010)
- Minimum monthly invoice: 80% of committed volume (i.e., invoiced minimum = 4.0B tokens equivalent)
- Overage: billed at $0.00075 / token
- One-time pilot credit: $25,000 (applied to first invoice)
- Contract conditions: standard MSA + SOW; any material redlines will require re-approval from Revenue leadership.

Attachments: redlined_MSA_v1.pdf (initial redline from our legal), pricing_worksheet_omega.xlsx, Omega_Discussion_Summary.pdf

Next steps: procurement to confirm billing cadence and send a PO. Legal (Aditya) will follow up on the MSA redlines; once signed we can generate first invoice and apply the pilot credit. If you prefer a stronger discount (40%), please note that will require SVP level sign-off and further margin analysis.

If this looks good, I'll prepare a DocuSign SOW and link it here.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
